no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held to discuss this application.

summary: The FDA review documents available in paperclip for NDA021968 (SUTENT / sunitinib malate) are the original approval letter and the s002-s006 supplement review packages; the original Orig1s000 review documents are not present. Every available review package states explicitly that no advisory committee meeting was held to discuss this application. There is therefore no AdComm record and no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
